LUPA PARA SA MGA MAGSASAKA!

Artists for Just Peace presents 'GAPAS!', a film program featuring films about peasant workers, on February 11, from 7:00 to 9:00 PM, at Chapterhouse, Quezon City. The screenings will be followed by a discussion on the farmers' struggle, leading up to the 7th anniversary of the Rice Liberalization Law (RLL) protest.

The lineup includes:
• ‘Bungkal’ by Lance Lozano
• ‘Ha’antu Ka Maku’ by Janina Magundayao
• ‘Saka Na’ by Cheska Marfori

Sign up here: https://t.co/C75WgfJwSn
